about-me:
I am a Senior Frontend Engineer / Software Engineer driven by a lifelong fascination with interactive experiences, a passion that began with gaming and evolved into building complex, scalable solutions. With over a decade of experience, I thrive on tackling technical challenges that sit at the intersection of creativity and logic.

Whether I’m architecting a new system or refining a user journey, I approach every project with a creator’s mindset: always looking for ways to make the solution more intuitive, the code more elegant, and the experience more engaging. I am a dedicated lifelong learner, a collaborative team player, and a leader who believes that the best software is built when technical excellence meets a shared creative vision.
